thesis: Margaret Chen argues that her background in political science and public policy provided the analytical skills and interdisciplinary perspective necessary to succeed in investing. She explains that while investing is an art requiring judgment rather than a science with predictable answers, her experience studying how institutions evolve and why people vote directly contributed to her ability to think critically about market dynamics.
